name: Stratum Logistics Hi-Vis Safety Vest
description: Blaze-orange mesh vest with retro-reflective silver tape running diagonally across the chest and back. Stratum Logistics logo stenciled in black on the left breast, faded from repeated washes. Front zip closure with two deep cargo pockets sized for handheld scanners.
functionality: High-visibility panels and reflective tape meet M88 transit authority safety standards for active freight yards and road-adjacent work zones.
what_it_says: You're on the clock, you're in the way, and the machinery will stop for you — barely.
story_hooks: A worker's vest has someone else's name patch still sewn on — the previous owner disappeared three weeks ago.
Stratum's new batch uses slightly different orange than the safety standard, making workers technically non-compliant — a detail a foreman is using selectively.

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian safety vest with high visibility orange mesh construction, creating an unmistakable industrial silhouette. Silver retro-reflective tape crosses diagonally across the chest and back, catching light at any angle. The faded Stratum Logistics logo on the left breast speaks to years of warehouse shifts and logistics hub duty.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed, oversized cut designed to layer over heavy work clothing without restriction. Sits loose on the shoulders and torso, allowing full range of motion for loading, scanning, and equipment handling.
physical_description.primary_material: Blaze-orange mesh polyester with thermoplastic retro-reflective tape (3M-grade or equivalent). Reinforced nylon trim on armholes and neckline for durability.
physical_description.texture: Lightweight mesh with an open weave pattern, slightly stiff from industrial laundering. The reflective tape has a smooth, rigid feel with subtle embossed surface pattern. Nylon trim is slightly worn and softened at edges.
physical_description.color_scheme: High-visibility blaze orange mesh base with silver retro-reflective diagonal striping. Black stenciled Stratum Logistics branding, slightly faded to dark charcoal from repeated washing cycles.
physical_description.closures: Full-length front zipper with plastic pull tab (standard industrial grade). Two large cargo pockets on the front with reinforced stress points.
distinctive_features: Diagonal retro-reflective striping across chest and back for 360-degree visibility
Faded black Stratum Logistics corporate logo on left breast pocket area
Worn zipper pull from daily use
Stress creases and faint staining patterns from warehouse environment
Reinforced pocket edges showing minor fraying
Mesh construction allows airflow in humid dock environments
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 working class. Corporate-issued safety equipment signals logistics/warehouse employment with major GLMZ cargo conglomerate.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearing this marks the wearer as Stratum Logistics workforce—dock workers, logistics coordinators, inventory scanners, or cargo handlers. The faded branding suggests months or years of consistent shifts. It's a badge of unglamorous but essential work in the supply chain that keeps the GLMZ functioning.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and weathered. Zipper moves smoothly but shows cosmetic wear. Mesh has minor snags. Reflective tape remains functional but dulled slightly from repeated friction. Overall serviceable but clearly used equipment, not fresh-from-inventory.

The blaze-orange mesh catches harsh overhead sodium lights, retro-reflective tape gleaming silver against dark surroundings. Worn condition, authentic sweat stains visible.
